0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000010_KRILE
0.description: Well done, sir. And with that, I believe we are ready to proceed.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000020_THANCRED
1.description: Let us be about our business then. The next patrol may not be so credulous.

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000030_KRILE
2.description: Why must you be so disappointingly brusque? You're not at all as Minfilia described, you know. I don't think you've favored me with so much as a single compliment since we set out.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000040_KRILE
3.description: Tell me, did your time in the wilderness sap you of all your charm, or are you holding it in reserve for your beloved?

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000050_THANCRED
4.description: This is neither the time nor the place.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000060_KRILE
5.description: Well, call me old-fashioned, but when I'm risking life and limb infiltrating an imperial castrum, I like to be sure of my comrades' motivations.

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000070_THANCRED
6.description: I see now where Alphinaud gets it from.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000080_THANCRED
7.description: Minfilia is dear to me, it is true─but not in the way you think.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000090_THANCRED
8.description: Fifteen years past, when she was still but a child, there was an incident at a parade. A goobbue broke free of its fetters and ran amok through the streets of Ul'dah. Had I been more attentive, I could have prevented it...but I was distracted, and her father was killed.

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000100_THANCRED
9.description: I feared she would never recover, but in the years that followed, she showed herself to be more resilient than I had ever imagined. And when she learned of her gift, she did not flinch from the responsibility, but sought to guide others on the path.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000110_THANCRED
10.description: She touched the hearts of all around her. Mine, Louisoix's, every Scion's. In those dark days following the Calamity, she was our guiding light─our hope for a brighter future.

11.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000120_THANCRED
11.description: She had so many dreams...and I would give anything to make them come true.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000130_KRILE
12.description: My apologies. I can see she means the world to you. I did not mean to pick at old scars.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000140_THANCRED
13.description: No harm done, I assure you. But fair is fair, my lady─what is Minfilia to you?

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000150_KRILE
14.description: You mean you don't know? Only my dearest friend.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000160_KRILE
15.description: When I finally emerged from my torpor, I learned that nary a day had passed without her asking after me. She never gave up hope.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000180_THANCRED
17.description: Then for Minfilia's sake, let us pray that these vestiges of Hydaelyn's intervention will lead us to her.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000200_MINFILIA
19.description: (-???-)Through time and space hast thou journeyed unto me...as I knew thou wouldst.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000210_MINFILIA
20.description: We are the Word of the Mother. We who were once called “Minfilia.”

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000220_MINFILIA
21.description: Much time hath passed for thee, since the bloody banquet. Since...since I hearkened to Her word.

22.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000230_MINFILIA
22.description: Mother... Hydaelyn guided me...towards Y'shtola and Thancred, that I might be swept up in their Flow...and delivered unto the aetherial sea...

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000240_MINFILIA
23.description: There, adrift and alone, Her voice silent once more, I prayed... For those we have lost. For those we can yet save. To Her I would make an offering...

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000250_MINFILIA
24.description: We speak now with one Voice. One Will. One Word. Unto thee we bequeath the most precious of gifts: the truth which lieth at the heart of this world.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000260_MINFILIA
25.description: Thus do we beseech thee once more... Hear... Feel... Think...

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000270_MINFILIA
26.description: Before there was life, in the depths of the aetherial sea, Light and Dark did once dwell as one.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000280_MINFILIA
27.description: But the Darkness coveted power, and the balance was broken. Thus was I forced to banish Him unto the distant heavens, to forever remain apart. A moon bound.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000290_MINFILIA
28.description: In sundering the star did we cry out, and the barriers 'twixt planes chance to falter.

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000300_MINFILIA
29.description: Across ten and three were we then divided. Reflections of the Source, each possessed of a shard.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000310_MINFILIA
30.description: Zodiark longeth to be made whole. For His restoration, for His resurrection, His servants labor without cease.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000320_MINFILIA
31.description: They seek to tear down the barriers which surround the Source.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000330_MINFILIA
32.description: Thus do they rejoice in their Ardor─in your calamities─for each marks a Rejoining.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000340_MINFILIA
33.description: Seven times have they succeeded. Seven times hath the Darkness grown stronger. Seven times have I failed.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000350_MINFILIA
34.description: The Ascians cannot be suffered to continue. This...this is my final...

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000360_MINFILIA
36.description: The Crystal's power is all but spent. With what remains, I will return you to the shore of the aetherial sea.

37.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000370_MINFILIA
37.description: Blessed children, go forth and seek...seek...

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000371_ALPHINAUD
38.description: You've had another vision, haven't you?

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000372_ALPHINAUD
39.description: Let us return to Master Matoya's cave. Everyone will wish to hear what you saw.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000390_THANCRED
41.description: Did you find her!? Did you find Minfilia!?

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000392_MATOYA
42.description: Still in one piece, are we?

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000400_ALPHINAUD
44.description: The Word of the Mother...? I am not sure I understand.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000420_KRILE
46.description: As unbelievable as it sounds, I see no reason to doubt her─the Word's tale. No one was more sensitive to the will of Hydaelyn than Minfilia.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000430_KRILE
47.description: And if Hydaelyn has grown so weak that She can barely make Herself heard, it is not hard to see why Minfilia, having joined with Her, might struggle to maintain her own form.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000440_ALPHINAUD
48.description: <hex:021A020203>What<hex:021A020103>? Why would she need to “maintain her own form”? Are you saying─ Are you saying she's gone?

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000450_ALPHINAUD
49.description: But that cannot be! Not now, not after all we have accomplished! We were meant to usher in the dawn's light together!

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000460_MATOYA
50.description: She threw herself on the fire to fuel your “dawn's light,” boy. You'll just have to usher it in on your own.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000480_MATOYA
52.description: Tell me about the Scions, boy.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000490_ALPHINAUD
53.description: The...the Scions of the Seventh Dawn labor for Eorzea's salvation.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000500_ALPHINAUD
54.description: Whenever the realm is threatened, be it by primal, Ascian, Garlean or any other, we take up arms in her defense, that all in Eorzea may live to see a brighter tomorrow.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000510_MATOYA
55.description: And that's very noble of you. But in chasing after these lofty goals of yours, you seem to have lost sight of some basic truths.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000520_MATOYA
56.description: To win a war, you must be willing to do whatever it takes. To fight, to kill, and, if necessary, to die.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000530_MATOYA
57.description: The path you've chosen is paved with the dead. Walk it with your eyes open, or not at all.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000540_YSHTOLA
58.description: I know the truth of which you speak, and have from the first.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000550_YSHTOLA
59.description: If the Ascians will go to any lengths to resurrect their god, then we must needs be as committed to our cause─to unmask them and their schemes, and to crush them both utterly.

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000560_YSHTOLA
60.description: Come. There is much to be done.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000590_ALPHINAUD
63.description: No... No, this is all wrong.

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000600_AYMERIC
64.description: A pleasure to see you again, my friend. I take it you received our invitation?

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000610_AYMERIC
65.description: Good, good... You of all people should be present.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000620_AYMERIC
66.description: When the True Brothers of the Faith seized control of the Vault, I feared the worst.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000630_AYMERIC
67.description: Yet in adversity were we blessed with the promise of peace between man and dragon, through Vidofnir's timely rescue of an innocent child. Timely, I say, though “miraculous” or “providential” might better describe the event. The gods themselves could not have devised a more fitting symbol of hope.

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000640_AYMERIC
68.description: Needless to say, we could scarce let such an opportunity pass us by, which is why I set about making formal arrangements for a peace conference between our peoples.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000650_AYMERIC
69.description: You and yours have done more to bring us together than any, and it is only right that you attend.

70.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000660_AYMERIC
70.description: But, I confess, that is not the only reason I would be glad to have you there. Given Nidhogg's implacable opposition to the peace, it is possible that he and his followers may attempt to disrupt proceedings, in which event, your presence would be a comfort to all in attendance.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000670_AYMERIC
71.description: Pray understand, I have no wish to invite the wyrm's ire, but if our fractured nation is to heal─if we are to move forward as a people united─then we must do whatever is necessary to bring about lasting change.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000680_AYMERIC
72.description: 'Tis nothing, 'tis nothing. <sigh> Lucia cautioned me against giving vent to my passions, lest my wounds reopen.

73.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000690_AYMERIC
73.description: It has not been easy reaching out to our opponents in Ishgard, many of whom sympathized with the actions of the “True Brothers.” But in so doing, we have limited the influence of the zealots.

74.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000700_AYMERIC
74.description: The people are ready, my friend. This conference <hex:021A020203>must<hex:021A020103> go ahead!

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000720_AYMERIC
76.description: The conference will take place on the border of Ishgardian and Dravanian territory, in Falcon's Nest.

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000730_AYMERIC
77.description: Lucia is there seeing to the final preparations even as we speak. Pray join her at your earliest convenience─'twould not do for the guest of honor to arrive late, after all.

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000750_AYMERIC
79.description: A drink! We should make time for one. Once the conference is concluded, I mean. By my reckoning, 'tis long overdue.

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000760_WAITRESS02236
80.description: Welcome, welcome! Find yourself an empty seat, and I'll be with you in a moment.

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000770_WAITRESS02236
81.description: Cold out, en't it? Here─a mug on the house. Let's get some color back in them cheeks!

82.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000780_WAITRESS02236
82.description: 'Fraid food'll be a bit longer than usual. We've got a lot of hungry folk to feed what with the conference and all.

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000790_WAITRESS02236
83.description: <sigh> So many people with cause to celebrate. To think there could be peace in our time, after all them years of fightin'...

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000800_WAITRESS02236
84.description: When I heard about the conference, I knew I had to come. I knew I had to be here─to do my bit.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000810_WAITRESS02236
85.description: My husband, he...he died fighting the dragons, you see... And here we are, about to break bread with them.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000820_WAITRESS02236
86.description: You all right, my lover? You look tired. Reckon you could do with a good long rest.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000830_WAITRESS02236
87.description: After all you've done, I'd say you've <hex:021A020203>earned<hex:021A020103> it.

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000840_WAITRESS02236
88.description: Sleep, now...sleeeeeep. Sleep and leave us to our affairs.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000870_OLDWOMAN02236
91.description: My son, they...they told me he walks in Halone's halls. Him and the rest of his unit.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000890_OLDWOMAN02236
93.description: I expect they think it's comforting.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000900_OLDWOMAN02236
94.description: Every time I come, I cry. I cannot bear to remember, but to forget would be a thousand times worse.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000910_OLDWOMAN02236
95.description: Yet that is what they would have us do. Accept this truth for the sake of peace. Bury the past and look to the future.

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000920_OLDWOMAN02236
96.description: But <hex:021A020203>he<hex:021A020103> was my future. My flesh and blood─my heart...

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000930_TRAITORB02236
97.description: Is this it? Are we the only ones with the courage to oppose this madness? Cowards, the lot of 'em!

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000940_TRAITORC02236
98.description: They think only of the prize─of the peace Ser Aymeric promises them. They know in their hearts it's a lie, but they go along with it anyway, desperate fools. But not I. Not I!

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000950_TRAITORC02236
99.description: I see the wyrm that killed my brother in my dreams every night! And I will not rest until he lies broken at my feet! Him and every last one of his accursed kin!

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000960_TRAITORB02236
100.description: All this nonsense about kings of eld. As if I care what they did or didn't do! Makes no difference to me and mine! Have the dragons sued for peace in a thousand years? Have they bollocks!

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000970_TRAITORB02236
101.description: It's a bloody ruse is what it is! And Ser Aymeric and the rest of 'em've bloody fallen for it!

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000980_OLDWOMAN02236
102.description: But what can we do? They believe, and naught we can say will ever change their minds.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_000990_OLDWOMAN02236
103.description: Whether we like it or not, man and dragon will come together at Falcon's Nest, and all will be forgiven. Forgiven and forgotten.

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001000_WAITRESS02236
104.description: No. I will not let that happen.

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001010_WAITRESS02236
105.description: They will remember the true face of the enemy. I will show it to them. And we will rise up against them once more!

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001020_THANCRED
106.description: Hey! Hey! This is no time for napping!

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001030_THANCRED
107.description: Do you have your wits about you? Good. Come with me─we have a crisis on our hands!

108.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001040_WAITRESS02236
108.description: Hear me, brothers and sisters! Do not be fooled by the honeyed words of the Dravanians! The peace they promise is but a prelude to slaughter!

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001050_WAITRESS02236
109.description: Remember your husbands and wives, never returned from war! Your children, torn apart by fang and claw! All your loved ones, shown no mercy!

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001060_WAITRESS02236
110.description: Does not your heart cry out for vengeance!? Your blood boil at the injustice!? Remember the face of your enemy, brothers and sisters! Remember it and strike back!

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001070_EMMANELLAIN
111.description: You there! Don't just stand around gawping! Do something, man! Stop her!

114.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001100_WAITRESS02236
114.description: See! See here the true nature of the highborn! With lies and deception they lead us to our doom, and dare we raise our voices in dissent─death is our reward!

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001110_WAITRESS02236
115.description: This is the choice they have given us, brothers and sisters! Death by dragon's fang or death by nobleman's command! Death to all we hold dear!

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001120_WAITRESS02236
116.description: I spit on your choices, nobleman! You will take no more from me... No more! NO MORE!

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001140_CAVALRY02236
118.description: I─ I only did as you ordered, my lord...

119.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001150_EMMANELLAIN
119.description: I gave no such order! I did not! I...I never meant for anyone to...

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001170_EMMANELLAIN
121.description: No, no! What have they done to you!? Honoroit! Honoroit!

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001180_HONOROIT
122.description: Is that you, my lord? You...you seem rather flustered.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001190_EMMANELLAIN
123.description: Because of you, you imbecile! What in the seven hells happened to you!?

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001200_HONOROIT
124.description: My...my apologies... Some few of the guests expressed a wish to leave...and I implored them to stay.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001210_HONOROIT
125.description: It would seem they took issue with my request.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001220_EMMANELLAIN
126.description: Gods forgive me... If I had only been more careful with my words!

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001230_HONOROIT
127.description: D-Do not blame yourself, my lord... I know... I know that you and your brother have Ishgard's best interests at heart.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001240_HONOROIT
128.description: That poor woman... She lives in the past, clinging to the memories of the lost.

129.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001250_HONOROIT
129.description: But the future holds so much promise. So much joy. And you...you know that better than any...

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001270_THANCRED
131.description: Calm yourself. The boy will live. But it's imperative we get him inside and into the care of a chirurgeon without delay.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001280_EMMANELLAIN
132.description: Gah! We were so close! Why does it all have to fall to pieces!?

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001290_EMMANELLAIN
133.description: Don't they <hex:021A020203>want<hex:021A020103> to live in peace!? Don't they <hex:021A020203>want<hex:021A020103> to be happy!? We all want the same thing, and still─STILL it falls to pieces!

134.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001300_EMMANELLAIN
134.description: Tell me: what─what was I supposed to do, hm!? Someone, anyone, tell me: <hex:021A020203>what was I supposed to do<hex:021A020103>!?

135.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001310_THANCRED
135.description: Stop looking to others. You make your choice and you live with the consequences.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001320_EMMANELLAIN
136.description: And what would <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> know about consequences!? You who always know just what to say, and just what to do! Your every deed is greeted with a round of applause!

137.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001330_THANCRED
137.description: You know <hex:021A020203>nothing<hex:021A020103> about me. I have fought tooth and nail for the people I hold dear─done <hex:021A020203>everything<hex:021A020103> in my power to save them...and I have failed.

138.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001340_THANCRED
138.description: Learn to live with it. I have.

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001350_EMMANELLAIN
139.description: Lord Commander, if I may. I wished to speak with you before the grand melee.

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001370_EMMANELLAIN
141.description: How do you do it, my lord? How do you lead with such certainty when so many of our countrymen will not hear of peace with the Dravanians?

142.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001380_EMMANELLAIN
142.description: Some of them hate you almost as much as the dragons themselves. They decry you as a patricide in the streets. They even tried to kill you, for gods' sakes! Yet still you march on, undaunted, where no archbishop dared to tread. What is your secret? Where do you find the strength?

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001390_AYMERIC
143.description: For centuries, our nation has been punished for the sins of our forefathers.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001400_AYMERIC
144.description: If our punishment is to end, I believe we must right the wrongs of antiquity and move forward as a nation united. Needless to say, my father did not share this opinion.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001410_AYMERIC
145.description: He did not believe the people strong enough to bring about their own deliverance, trusting only in himself. Tyranny seemed to him the only solution.

146.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001420_AYMERIC
146.description: But I have faith in the people, Lord Emmanellain. I have faith that they will weather this storm, and overcome every trial we set before them.

147.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001430_AYMERIC
147.description: Many have fought and died to see this blight upon our nation's history cleansed, and I would not let their sacrifices be in vain. Though we invite reprisals, the risk is worth the reward.

149.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001450_EMMANELLAIN
149.description: Lord Commander─through my careless orders, a pall has been cast over these proceedings, and I beg the opportunity to make amends.

150.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001460_EMMANELLAIN
150.description: I, Emmanellain de Fortemps, do hereby request leave to take part in the grand melee!

151.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001470_AYMERIC
151.description: Who am I to deny such a heartfelt plea? We would be honored to have you join the fray, my lord.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001480_EDMONT
152.description: You will take charge of the Ishgardian forces?

153.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001490_AYMERIC
153.description: For all my other responsibilities, I am still lord commander of the Temple Knights, and I would not soon yield this duty to another.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001500_EDMONT
154.description: The esteemed Ser Aymeric, leading the Temple Knights and the watch into battle, along with my youngest. I could wish for no more.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001510_AYMERIC
155.description: Then you wish for too little, my lord! There is another who might yet join the fray. An indispensable ally to whom we owe much and more.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001520_AYMERIC
156.description: An adventurer beholden to none, who nevertheless chose to champion our cause. Who has shared in our suffering, and in our glory.

157.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001530_AYMERIC
157.description: A warrior without equal, whom I am privileged to call a friend. There is no one I would rather have fighting by my side.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001540_AYMERIC
158.description: I ask this in full knowledge of your obligations, and will not think less of you should you refuse. But if your conscience will allow it, might you oblige me, my friend? One more time?

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001550_AYMERIC
159.description: Ha! Together, we shall give the people a spectacle for the ages─a celebration to mark the dawning of a new era!

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001560_AYMERIC
160.description: Let all here present heed well the rules of engagement!

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001561_SYSTEM_000
161.description: The grand melee is a large-scale battle in which an allied company of Ul'dahn, Gridanian, and Lominsan forces will be pitted against a company of Ishgardian forces.

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001561_SYSTEM_010
162.description: When a combatant is incapacitated, the opposing company will be awarded <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>tactical points<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001561_SYSTEM_020
163.description: The first company to attain the designated tactical rating of <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>100 points<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> is declared the victor.

164.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001561_SYSTEM_030
164.description: During the grand melee, officiants may mark certain combatants with the <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Fury's Gaze<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which will be indicated by an aetherial tether linking them to their company's flag.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001561_SYSTEM_040
165.description: While defeating most combatants will award your company 1 tactical point, defeating marked combatants will award your company 10 tactical points.

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001561_SYSTEM_050
166.description: Marked combatants also possess enhanced attributes, rendering them more powerful and more difficult to defeat.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001561_SYSTEM_060
167.description: Defending and defeating these combatants is the key to victory!

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001570_AYMERIC
168.description: For the honor and the glory of Ishgard!

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001580_NANAMOULNAMO
169.description: All is ready, then. Very well.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001590_NANAMOULNAMO
170.description: Brave men and women of the Eorzean Alliance. Let the grand melee begin!

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001620_AYMERIC
173.description: Well fought! Well fought, my friend! You truly are the warrior of warriors! Thank the Fury you were on our side!

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001630_EMMANELLAIN
174.description: Hah hah...my lungs are burning, and I can barely stand!

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001640_EMMANELLAIN
175.description: I didn't think I could do it...but then I did! We did! We faced the Alliance's best, and together, with one heart, with one purpose, we prevailed!

176.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001650_EMMANELLAIN
176.description: After a thousand years of hardship, of strife and bloodshed, we are strong enough to rise to any challenge─be it on the battlefield or beyond.

177.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001660_EMMANELLAIN
177.description: The future holds so much promise. So much joy. We need only show them the way.

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001670_NANAMOULNAMO
178.description: A truly magnificent display, ser knight. While doubtless less than pleased, I am quite sure the Grand Companies are <hex:021A020203>honored<hex:021A020103> to have been bested by such valiant warriors.

179.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001680_AYMERIC
179.description: The honor was ours, Your Grace.

180.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001690_NANAMOULNAMO
180.description: I am pleased to see that Ishgard's proud martial tradition is being upheld.

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001700_NANAMOULNAMO
181.description: When the time comes, I trust you will fight alongside your brothers and sisters in the Eorzean Alliance with the same fervor you displayed in opposing them.

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001710_NANAMOULNAMO
182.description: I note that our friend elected to take the field in Ishgardian colors.

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001720_AYMERIC
183.description: At my behest, Your Grace. If we have given offense, the blame lies with me.

184.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001730_NANAMOULNAMO
184.description: Fear not, ser knight. It was a surprise, nothing more. And any hint of ill-feeling was thoroughly dispelled by the spectacle of our mutual friend's duel with General Raubahn.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001740_NANAMOULNAMO
185.description: On the subject of surprises, I could not help but marvel at the passion and unity of purpose displayed by your countrymen...given the troubling reports we have received of late.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001750_AYMERIC
186.description: I shall take that as a compliment, Your Grace. The events to which you allude are the price of change. The end of the Dragonsong War marks the beginning of a new era for our nation─and for the <hex:021A020203>people<hex:021A020103>, high- and lowborn alike, who will lead her into the future.

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001770_NANAMOULNAMO
188.description: Change is indeed a perilous thing, for we who seek it and they who fear it. I shall pray for Ishgard─and for you.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001780_THANCRED
189.description: Well, that made for a refreshing change. Congratulations on your victory, by the way.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001790_THANCRED
190.description: The Ishgardians certainly seem happy with themselves. I, for my part, am merely glad you did not strain anything in the process of single-handedly winning the battle for them.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001810_THANCRED
192.description: 'Tis but a scratch, I assure you. And I will not suffer you to worry over me─not when we have a dozen far more important concerns.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001820_THANCRED
193.description: ...Make that two dozen. Still, as Y'shtola never tires of telling me, we can but face them head-on, one at a time. One day at a time...as Minfilia would have done.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001840_EMMANELLAIN
195.description: Honoroit, my boy! Shouldn't you be in bed?

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001850_HONOROIT
196.description: Thank you for your concern, my lord, but I have largely recovered from my ordeal, and I have naught but several scars to show for it. Which, I have been told, some women may find...appealing.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001860_EMMANELLAIN
197.description: I see! And to think I was worried sick over you!

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001870_HONOROIT
198.description: I'm not sure I understand, my lord.

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001880_EMMANELLAIN
199.description: Well, let's put that theory to the proof, shall we?

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001900_ALPHINAUD
201.description: 'Twould seem that a great many things have occurred in my absence. I thought I might begin to make amends by welcoming you in person.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001910_EDMONT
202.description: The messengers spared not their chocobos to bring us word of your victory in the grand melee. I cannot well describe our elation when we heard the news.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001920_EDMONT
203.description: It called to mind the day we rejoined the Eorzean Alliance, when I glimpsed hope rekindled in the eyes of the people.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001930_LUCIA
204.description: The Fury Herself ushers us into a new era. Ser Aymeric, the time is now!

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001940_AYMERIC
205.description: Aye, that it is. Reconvene the conference and summon Vidofnir to Falcon's Nest.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001950_AYMERIC
206.description: We will make peace with Hraesvelgr's brood and hasten this bloody war to its end.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001970_EDMONT
208.description: I will send word to Artoirel and bid him resume preparations.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001980_EDMONT
209.description: Emmanellain─you will place yourself at your brother's disposal. He will be glad of your assistance.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_001990_THANCRED
210.description: No stopping it now, is there? We should inform Y'shtola and the others.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002000_AYMERIC
211.description: My dear friend...I doubt I will ever be able to thank you enough. But when the conference is successfully concluded, I damn well mean to try.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002030_LUCIA
214.description: She begged leave to watch the proceedings. I saw no reason not to grant it.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002040_AYMERIC
215.description: Should I choose to deviate from my prepared remarks, I ask that you trust in my judgment.

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002080_VIDOFNIR
219.description: Ah, how long it hath been since our peoples met thus, children of Thordan. Even by our reckoning.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002090_AYMERIC
220.description: Vidofnir, daughter of Hraesvelgr, we give thanks for your visit and bid you welcome to Falcon's Nest.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002100_VIDOFNIR
221.description: Our sire bade us hearken unto the whispers of our hearts. They spoke to us of a paradise lost─of bonds of brotherhood which they yearn to see restored.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002110_AYMERIC
222.description: Ours too yearn for such a restoration. And they have guided us here this day, that they might yearn no longer.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002120_AYMERIC
223.description: Brothers and sisters, ye who stand as witness, hearken to me!

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002130_AYMERIC
224.description: Since the days of eld, when the bonds betwixt man and dragon were sundered by our hand, our peoples have known only war.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002140_AYMERIC
225.description: Bloodshed without end, losses beyond counting─and still we fought. And still we fought.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002150_AYMERIC
226.description: Some wounds do not heal. The dead cannot be returned to us.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002160_AYMERIC
227.description: But we the living can yet choose another course. Here and now, we can lay down this burden─this hatred, this vengeance.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002170_AYMERIC
228.description: Our forebears fought not so that we could die, but that we might live! So let us honor their sacrifice and spare our children this death sentence. Let us gift them a new legacy. Life!

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002180_VIDOFNIR
229.description: Betwixt our peoples yawneth a divide deeper than the deepest abyss; wider than the widest sea.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002190_VIDOFNIR
230.description: Generations will live and die ere this divide is bridged. Knowing this, doth thy heart yet yearn for peace, son of Thordan?

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002200_AYMERIC
231.description: Look now on the legacy we would leave to our children. A dream of peace inscribed in stone for generations to come.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002210_VIDOFNIR
232.description: Father and his beloved. As they were so long ago. Happy and at peace.

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002220_VIDOFNIR
233.description: The dream they shared shall be ours once more.

237.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002260_ESTINIEN
237.description: Child of Dravania! Art thou grown so forgetful that thou wouldst forsake kith and kin, and consort with the spawn of Thordan? That thou wouldst <hex:021A020203>dare<hex:021A020103> contemplate peace!

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002270_ESTINIEN
238.description: Hearken unto me, all of you! The final chorus is nigh, and all will be held to account! All will bathe in the flames of retribution!

239.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002280_ESTINIEN
239.description: Till the coming of that day, look you on your sins and despair! For none shall 'scape my wrath! None shall 'scape my revenge!

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002310_CITIZENA02240
242.description: Hells take that wyrm! While he lives, we'll never know peace!

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002320_CITIZENB02240
243.description: Aye, there'll be no end to this war till Nidhogg is dead and gone!

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002330_CITIZENC02240
244.description: So let's kill the bastard and be done with it! Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002340_CITIZENA02240
245.description: (-Angry Mob-)Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!<hex:02100103>Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!<hex:02100103>Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002350_CITIZENB02240
246.description: (-Angry Mob-)Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!<hex:02100103>Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!<hex:02100103>Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002360_CITIZENC02240
247.description: (-Angry Mob-)Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!<hex:02100103>Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!<hex:02100103>Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002361_CITIZENA02240
248.description: (-Angry Mob-)Death to the wyrm! Death to Nidhogg!<hex:02100103>Death to the wyrm! Death to Nidhogg!<hex:02100103>Death to the wyrm! Death to Nidhogg!

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002362_CITIZENB02240
249.description: (-Angry Mob-)Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!<hex:02100103>Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002363_CITIZENC02240
250.description: (-Angry Mob-)Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!<hex:02100103>Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!<hex:02100103>Death to Nidhogg! Death to Nidhogg!

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002370_KRILE
251.description: Of all the ways for it to end.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002380_KRILE
252.description: Even before his transformation, I could feel the wyrm's hatred swirling about Estinien. The terrible, all-consuming rage...

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002390_KRILE
253.description: Enough to fuel a thousand-year quest for vengeance. It was all I could do not to run away screaming.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002400_KRILE
254.description: But Ishgardians─nay, all Eorzeans─are made of sterner stuff. They face danger and death on a daily basis, and understand what it takes to win a war.

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002410_YSHTOLA
255.description: Think not too deeply on Master Matoya's words. Her intent was but to steel our resolve.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002420_YSHTOLA
256.description: That, and to remind us to look beyond these passing conflicts to trials greater still─to the truth which hides at the heart of this world.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002430_KRILE
257.description: So that's your aim, is it?

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002450_KRILE
259.description: Not at all! I believe it's traditional for the student to follow in the footsteps of the master. And you are so very alike.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002460_ALPHINAUD
260.description: Forgive me. That took longer than expected.

261.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002470_ALPHINAUD
261.description: ...You seem puzzled. Oh, these? I thought something warming might not go amiss.

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002480_ALPHINAUD
262.description: It was not all that long ago that we sat here, you and I. In our very own “Falling Snows,” as Lord Haurchefant called it.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002490_ALPHINAUD
263.description: I still struggle to believe he has gone. And Ysayle too... I had such hopes for her...

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002500_ALPHINAUD
264.description: Master Matoya asked me what it was all for. Why we fight...and why we die.

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002510_ALPHINAUD
265.description: Were I still commander of the Braves, I would doubtless have replied, “For the future of Eorzea,” but I am not that man. Not anymore.

266.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002520_ALPHINAUD
266.description: I needed a new answer. One that I could live with. And when I saw Estinien at the ceremony, I knew at last what it was.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002530_ALPHINAUD
267.description: I do not want to be a man who sacrifices his friends and family for a cause. I want to fight for Estinien─and I want to save him.

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002540_ALPHINAUD
268.description: When Nidhogg leads the Horde into battle, Ser Aymeric and his forces will do what they believe must be done.

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002550_ALPHINAUD
269.description: That is their choice to make. Yet even if Ser Aymeric is willing to forsake Estinien, I am not.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002560_ALPHINAUD
270.description: We must fight for him, for he is our friend and ally. We may struggle, we may fail, but we must try.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_A1_000_001
272.description: We will find a way to save him.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002570_ALPHINAUD
275.description: We will. I know we will.

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002580_ALPHINAUD
276.description: Lord Haurchefant would be proud. I knew you would understand! Together, we will surely find a way.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002590_ALPHINAUD
277.description: Forgive me. I say these things to you in full knowledge of the fact that you have never yet given up on a friend. We will find a way. I know we will.

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002600_EDMONT
278.description: Change─that great, inexorable wave─was upon us, and soon all of Ishgard would bend to its will.

279.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002610_EDMONT
279.description: For all our sins, for all our scars, the future for which we had long yearned was at last within our grasp.

280.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002620_EDMONT
280.description: But it would be bought at a heavy price.

281.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002630_EDMONT
281.description: For in those twilight hours did Nidhogg cry out for vengeance,<hex:02100103>and his brethren raise their voices for the final chorus of the Dragonsong War.

282.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_03200_002640_SYSTEM
282.description: From the memoirs of Count Edmont de Fortemps<hex:02100103><hex:021A020203>Heavensward: The Gears of Change<hex:021A020103>
